episodes.title: Enchanted to Meet You
episodes.description: Singles connect over astrology, dad jokes and musical tastes as they begin searching for love.

episodes.title: What a Woman!
episodes.description: Conversations deepen into health diagnoses and parenthood as the singles look for genuine chemistry.

episodes.title: Together at Last
episodes.description: One couple gets engaged while love triangles, careless remarks and missed opportunities complicate other connections.

episodes.title: Sink or Swim
episodes.description: Two more couples prepare to meet face to face and discover whether their emotional connections translate into attraction.

episodes.title: Here Comes the Dud
episodes.description: The newly engaged couples travel to a luxury Mexican resort to explore their physical chemistry.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Undervale
episodes.description: Katherine hires an exorcist to attract paying guests; Ben finds an unexpected romantic connection.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.description: Esther befriends a rebellious ghost. A blackout sends Nathan, Ben and Abaddon into the woods.

episodes.title: Randy Slasher
episodes.description: Katherine prepares for a date while everyone else confronts a killer targeting teenagers.

episodes.title: How to Train Your Demon
episodes.description: Abaddon wrestles with his instincts; Katherine meets a rival; the others investigate a possible werewolf.

episodes.title: Rollyfluffs
episodes.description: Esther starts a dangerous school trend while the honeymoon suite becomes unexpectedly seductive.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunters!
episodes.description: Paranormal investigators film at the hotel; Ben confides his relationship troubles to a magical diary.

episodes.title: Seven Deadly Bens
episodes.description: Ben develops multiple personalities in pursuit of confidence; Nathan repeatedly falls through floors.

episodes.title: Aunt Rose
episodes.description: An unwelcome relative settles in, Abaddon battles a doorstop, and Esther tries raising the dead.

episodes.title: The Esthercist
episodes.description: Esther confronts invading demons while Katherine reveals a painful truth about Nathan's death.

episodes.title: The Acolytes of Abaddon
episodes.description: A busload of potential guests arrives, but their cult may threaten the world.

episodes.title: Ooze
episodes.description: Katherine recruits staff as business improves, but the ideal candidate faces the hotel's terrifying working conditions.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.description: Ben hosts an awkward dinner for Annabelle, Katherine anticipates trouble, and Esther's friendship with Abaddon is tested.

episodes.title: The Witch
episodes.description: The family helps a demanding witch, Nathan struggles to discuss his afterlife, and Abaddon takes on food preparation.

episodes.title: Ghost Day Out
episodes.description: A rare night of freedom gives Nathan renewed purpose while Katherine stays home with an unusually angelic Abaddon.

episodes.title: Astral Esther
episodes.description: Katherine and Shayna help Esther recover her body after astral projection goes wrong; the others visit a mermaid-haunted lake.
episodes.title_note: Rotten Tomatoes lists Astral Esther; IMDb, Metacritic and JustWatch list Astral Ether. Not independently settled against Netflix season-two metadata.

episodes.title: Dante Crowe
episodes.description: A gunslinging ghost hunter draws the family into an apocalyptic struggle while Abaddon follows a wild calling.

episodes.title: The Concierge
episodes.description: Esther manages Nathan's campaign for Ghost Mayor; a many-limbed concierge helps Katherine and unsettles Ben.

episodes.title: The Visit
episodes.description: Katherine revisits her first stay with a living Nathan, hoping memories of their family's past can save the hotel.
